configuration.P: Phenomenal numeric pass in both ID and OOD.
configuration.M: All planned probes numeric pass in both ID and OOD; P Validation => M failure by user policy.
configuration.core_repeats: Pool three independent attempts, never best-of; replicate mean and sample SD also provided.
configuration.full: Groups2+3 only, 512 unique tasks, first replicate; group5 repeats are not added to Full.
configuration.missing: Keep unknown separate. Rate judged excludes unknown; rate plan is separately labeled confirmed lower bound, not a scientific failure assignment.
configuration.source_strata: Mixed original/patched environments and OpenRouter/BigModel history, plus43 labeled posthoc recoveries; not a clean single-protocol comparison.
